```yaml
name: PR Size Labeler

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  pr-size-labeler:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Label PR by size
        uses: codelytv/pr-size-labeler@v1
        with:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          xs_label: 'size/xs'
          xs_max_size: '10'
          s_label: 'size/s'
          s_max_size: '100'
          m_label: 'size/m'
          m_max_size: '500'
          l_label: 'size/l'
          l_max_size: '1000'
          xl_label: 'size/xl'
          fail_if_xl: 'false'
          files_to_ignore: ''
          message_if_xl: ''
```
